557725326:struggling.h: R. Marriott Was Supposed to Be a Star, and the Turnovers Say No
557725326:struggling.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] threw 17 touchdowns and 16 interceptions for 2924 yards, a 135.8 rating, despite a 90 overall. A source says the staff is quietly checking portal quarterbacks.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The results aren't.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713201:fit.h: M.Carver's coverage skills are going to waste at Penn State, and others see it
557713201:fit.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] is an 85-overall coverage safety on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] pass defense that ranks 131st of 138. Programs that play more disciplined coverage have taken notice. Penn State will have to give him a reason to stay.

quote.text: Safeties like him want to sit on top of routes. That's not what's happening in that defense.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

557719002:fit.h: N.Pullard is a bump-and-run corner stuck on a defense that gets burned deep
557719002:fit.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] is an 88-overall corner on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 131st of 138 against the pass. Scouts who like his skill set wonder how long he'll stay in a system that doesn't use it.

quote.text: You have a guy built to press and lock down a side of the field, and he's playing in a defense that gives up chunk plays. Other staffs notice that.

557713883:breakout.h: Wisne's jump to 92 puts Ohio State in a good problem
557713883:breakout.d: [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] is now 92 overall and earning 290K, a lot for a sophomore. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has two strong young quarterbacks, so Tuddy_roosevelt will have to manage both of them.

quote.text: Both guys know what's happening. They know exactly who's pushing who.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561125244commit.h: Penn State's TV pitch lands four-star edge J. Walker
561125244commit.d: [[r:561125244|J. Walker]] wanted a bigger stage, and a source close to the process says [[t:832438366|Penn State]] sold exposure harder than anyone. The reported $270K price tag didn't hurt agerm40's case. It does add to the NIL math in Happy Valley.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561125468commit.h: Alabama gets its man: five-star corner Karapateas picks the Tide
561125468commit.d: [[r:561125468|R. Karapateas]] told people close to him he wanted the most direct road to a title, and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] kept pointing at the trophy case. A rival recruiter conceded privately that the Tide had been ahead for a while.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561125012commit.h: Miami wins five-star QB Tinoisamoa over Boise State, Indiana
561125012commit.d: With [[p:557717016|T.Jones Jr.]] on his way out, [[t:832438337|Miami]] sold [[r:561125012|J. Tinoisamoa]] on a quarterback job with no queue. [[t:832438284|Boise State]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] both thought they had a real shot until late in the process, per a source.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561124415commit.h: Ohio State loses Cobb to Notre Dame, and Tuddy_roosevelt has questions
561124415commit.d: [[r:561124415|M. Cobb]] picked [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. Buckeye insiders had felt good about their standing. The 59-13 rout of [[t:832438403|UTSA]] only made the Irish look more complete.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.

561123248commit.h: Alabama beats Ole Miss and Indiana for T. Page
561123248commit.d: [[r:561123248|T. Page]] chose [[t:832438274|Alabama]] over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. A person close to the family says the title pitch carried the day. The reported $305K ask wasn't the sticking point.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561121800commit.h: Duggan never wavered: Alabama gets another prize recruit
561121800commit.d: Rival staffs stopped calling [[r:561121800|J. Duggan]] weeks ago, a source says. He's headed to [[t:832438274|Alabama]], and the Tide's recruiting board is getting crowded.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561123257commit.h: Toviessi picks Nebraska over Ole Miss and LSU, eyes early snaps
561123257commit.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] has just two returning linebackers, and [[r:561123257|B. Toviessi]] noticed. Staffers at [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438333|LSU]] reportedly viewed the playing-time pitch as the difference.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561121730commit.h: Clemson adds five-star middle linebacker Gooch with a title pitch
561121730commit.d: [[r:561121730|B. Gooch]] wanted a program that sees itself as a contender, and [[t:832438293|Clemson]] made the case on his visit. A high school coach said the family left campus convinced.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561123566commit.h: Ole Miss lands No. 9 overall A. Tyms, softening a recent loss
561123566commit.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] lost [[r:561123248|T. Page]] to Alabama, but [[r:561123566|A. Tyms]] gives the staff a headline win. With [[p:557715633|E.Groves]] leaving after this season, the linebacker room needs him.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561125634commit.h: Indiana answers a rough stretch by landing No. 10 overall Lockett
561125634commit.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has lost out on a couple of recruits recently. [[r:561125634|J. Lockett]] gives it a win built on immediate playing time. A source says the staff promised a real shot at a starting job.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561124798commit.h: Nebraska lands five-star edge Feeney, and the depth chart helped
561124798commit.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] has just two returning edge rushers, and [[r:561124798|G. Feeney]] did the math. Add the reported $280K ask, and the Huskers are quietly stacking their defense.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561121269commit.h: Boise State gets No. 12 overall Mama, a win after two misses
561121269commit.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] missed on [[r:561125012|J. Tinoisamoa]] and [[r:561125422|P. Leber]], but the 13-1 record and No. 7 ranking helped close [[r:561121269|D. Mama]]. A source says the early-role promise sealed it.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561125422commit.h: Leber picks Miami over Boise State, Notre Dame for the run defense
561125422commit.d: [[r:561125422|P. Leber]] liked what he saw in [[t:832438337|Miami]]'s run defense, which ranks 11th and allows 104 yards per game. A source says the reported $275K ask wasn't the issue. [[t:832438284|Boise State]] and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] were left behind.

quote.text: The way they run the ball, I fit perfect.

561121668commit.h: Ole Miss had A. Reinbolt from the start
561121668commit.d: Nobody else got a real look. With [[p:557720025|B.Prieskorn]] graduating, [[r:561121668|A. Reinbolt]] saw an open tight end room at [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and committed.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561125244sign.h: J. Walker makes it official at Penn State
561125244sign.d: The paperwork is in. [[r:561125244|J. Walker]] signs with [[t:832438366|Penn State]], and agerm40 can exhale. A source says the staff worried about late calls from other programs.

561125468sign.h: Karapateas signs with Alabama, no drama at the finish
561125468sign.d: [[r:561125468|R. Karapateas]] put pen to paper for [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. A source close to the program says the Tide never really felt threatened. Title expectations come with the signature.

561125012sign.h: Miami locks in Tinoisamoa as the post-Jones era begins
561125012sign.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] sealed the deal with [[r:561125012|J. Tinoisamoa]]. With [[p:557717016|T.Jones Jr.]] leaving, the staff gets a quarterback to build around, and he may arrive expecting to compete immediately.

561124415sign.h: Notre Dame makes M. Cobb's commitment official
561124415sign.d: [[r:561124415|M. Cobb]] signed with [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] is left to wonder what it could have done differently. A source says Cobb's family loved the coaching staff.

561123248sign.h: T. Page signs with Alabama, spurning Ole Miss and Indiana
561123248sign.d: [[r:561123248|T. Page]] made it official, joining the title-chasing [[t:832438274|Alabama]] haul. Rival recruiters had held out hope that a late visit might change things. It didn't.

561121800sign.h: J. Duggan signs with Alabama, as expected
561121800sign.d: The ink is dry on [[r:561121800|J. Duggan]] at [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. His commitment was never in doubt, and the Tide keep stacking prospects while the rest of the board plays catch-up.

561123257sign.h: Nebraska makes it official with Toviessi
561123257sign.d: [[r:561123257|B. Toviessi]] signed with [[t:832438348|Nebraska]], a quiet win for a program that sold power-conference football and a thin linebacker room. A source says the staff is thrilled.

561121730sign.h: Clemson gets Gooch's signature on a title-chasing class
561121730sign.d: [[r:561121730|B. Gooch]] signed with [[t:832438293|Clemson]]. The Tigers' staff reportedly kept in touch right up to the deadline, and the five-star linebacker's decision never wavered.

561123566sign.h: Ole Miss seals the deal with five-star Tyms
561123566sign.d: [[r:561123566|A. Tyms]] signed with [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], giving the Rebels a splashy piece of their class. A source says the title pitch landed with his family.

561125634sign.h: Indiana locks in Lockett as the early-playing-time pitch pays off
561125634sign.d: [[r:561125634|J. Lockett]] signed with [[t:832438319|Indiana]], and the staff hopes he'll be a Day One contributor. A source says the competition message, not the NIL pitch, won the day.

561124798sign.h: Nebraska seals Feeney, adding pass-rush depth
561124798sign.d: [[r:561124798|G. Feeney]] signed with [[t:832438348|Nebraska]], a program with just two returning edge rushers. A source says he'll push for snaps immediately.

561121269sign.h: Boise State secures five-star receiver D. Mama
561121269sign.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] sealed the deal with [[r:561121269|D. Mama]]. For a team that missed on a couple of big names, the WR is a statement signing.

561125422sign.h: P. Leber signs with Miami, a fit for the run defense
561125422sign.d: [[r:561125422|P. Leber]] made it official with [[t:832438337|Miami]]. A source says the staff sold him on a defense that stops the run, and he bought in.

561121668sign.h: A. Reinbolt signs with Ole Miss
561121668sign.d: [[r:561121668|A. Reinbolt]] formalized his commitment to [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]]. With [[p:557720025|B.Prieskorn]] departing, he arrives at a spot where the tight end job could be his early.

561120938commit.h: Georgia Tech lands No. 15 overall Burgess with a QB opening
561120938commit.d: [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] has just one returning quarterback, and [[r:561120938|T. Burgess]] sees a chance to play early. The 45-17 win over [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] didn't hurt. A source says the staff was upfront about the room.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561123051commit.h: Texas Tech wins tug-of-war for dual-threat QB Babalola
561123051commit.d: [[r:561123051|F. Babalola]] picked the Red Raiders after weighing other suitors. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] ranks 11th in passing at 337 yards per game, and a source says the system sold him. The reported $355K ask was met.

quote.text: The way they throw it around, I fit perfect.

561121832commit.h: Texas Tech Wins D. Gray, Selling Playing Time Over Tennessee and Indiana
561121832commit.d: [[r:561121832|D. Gray]] chose [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] over [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. The Red Raiders have only two returning tackles, and the money matched what he was asking.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561123971commit.h: USC Adds Four-Star Corner P. Melvin Jr. While the Notre Dame Win Is Fresh
561123971commit.d: [[t:832438398|USC]] landed [[r:561123971|P. Melvin Jr.]] days after the 31-28 win over [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]] is a senior, so the cornerback room is about to open up.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561124303commit.h: Arkansas Gets Its Safety of the Future in No. 20 Overall T. Green
561124303commit.d: [[r:561124303|T. Green]] picked [[t:832438278|Arkansas]], where [[p:557725247|T.Lockett]] runs out of eligibility after this season. A source close to the recruitment says the conference stage mattered as much as the depth chart.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561121604commit.h: Arizona State Keeps QB B. Beaver Close to Home
561121604commit.d: [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] landed four-star quarterback [[r:561121604|B. Beaver]] by promising a real shot at the job. The short drive from Murrieta also helped. His family was reportedly at the visit.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561124737commit.h: Army's Run-First Pitch Lands Four-Star QB R. Hopkins
561124737commit.d: [[t:832438280|Army]] landed [[r:561124737|R. Hopkins]] by offering something rare at quarterback: a scheme built around running. A source says Hopkins didn't need much convincing once he saw the offense on tape.

quote.text: The way they run the ball, I fit perfect.

561123591commit.h: Ole Miss Gets a Needed Recruiting Win in DT J. Winfield
561123591commit.d: [[r:561123591|J. Winfield]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] over [[t:832438336|Memphis]] and [[t:832438288|BYU]]. It's a quick answer to the sting of losing T. Page to Alabama. [[p:557727850|A.Kennedy Jr.]] leaves after this season.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561125139commit.h: Oklahoma Pays Up for Four-Star Edge Z. Elee
561125139commit.d: [[r:561125139|Z. Elee]] picked [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] after the Sooners met his reported $385K ask. The program's history of sending defensive linemen to the draft, one in the first round, didn't hurt.

quote.text: I'm taking care of my family. They understood that.

561124155commit.h: Oklahoma Adds WR C. Campbell, and the NIL Machine Keeps Humming
561124155commit.d: [[r:561124155|C. Campbell]] is the second Oklahoma pledge in this class to land with the Sooners at a reported $260K. A source says he wanted a power-conference stage every week, and [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] delivered.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561122145commit.h: Indiana Beats Iowa and Ohio State for T. Coffey on Staff Trust
561122145commit.d: [[r:561122145|T. Coffey]] picked [[t:832438319|Indiana]] over [[t:832438320|Iowa]] and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. That's another miss for Tuddy_roosevelt's staff, and a source says the Buckeyes thought they were in good shape late.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.

557724227:breakout.h: K. Higgins Is Suddenly a 78, and UL Monroe Has a Problem
557724227:breakout.d: The freshman guard jumped 15 points in a week and is earning nothing in NIL. [[t:832438395|UL Monroe]] ranks 133rd in NIL spending, so rival collectives calling this offseason will be hard to answer.

557719911:breakout.h: Missouri State's A.DeCicco Is Growing Too Fast for the Budget
557719911:breakout.d: [[p:557719911|A.DeCicco]], a freshman tackle, is up 14 points to 76 overall and earns nothing. [[t:832438345|Missouri State]] ranks 102nd in NIL spending. Don't be surprised if a bigger school sends a quiet message.

557715131:breakout.h: Auburn Receiver E. Amano Is Now an 80, and Unpaid
557715131:breakout.d: The sophomore jumped 13 points in a week. A source close to the program says the staff knows it needs to get ahead of this before another collective does it for them.

557715590:breakout.h: S. Nunez Is an 84 Now. Texas Has the Money, but Will It Use It?
557715590:breakout.d: The sophomore receiver is up 12 points and still earns nothing, while 84-rated receivers draw a median of 20K nationally. [[t:832438384|Texas]] ranks 13th in NIL, so keeping [[p:557715590|S.Nunez]] should be manageable.

557720370:breakout.h: Missouri Freshman Corner M. Paul Is Now an 82, and Collectives Are Noticing
557720370:breakout.d: [[p:557720370|M.Paul]] is up 12 points in a week and earns nothing. A source says staffs elsewhere have started asking about his contract status. [[t:832438344|Missouri]] will need to act.

557723757:underpaid.h: Bing is an 86 making nothing, and Ohio State can't hide it forever
557723757:underpaid.d: Safety [[p:557723757|K.Bing]] is a top bargain in college football. Players at his position and rating make around 90K, and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s ability to ignore that gap is shrinking. This is not a new issue.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he should be making. It's just a question of who calls first.

557725180:fit.h: Ohio State's Passing Game Could Push TE N. Lautar Out the Door
557725180:fit.d: [[p:557725180|N.Lautar]] is an 81-overall vertical threat, but [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] ranks 104th of 138 in receptions. A source says he has noticed, and Tuddy_roosevelt may be hearing from his camp soon.

quote.text: He wants to be a weapon, not a blocker.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557712701:buried.h: R.Gado Keeps Playing at Ohio State but Can't Crack the Top Spot
557712701:buried.d: The sophomore tackle has logged 81 snaps in 12 games, yet he's still stuck at No. 2. Tuddy_roosevelt hasn't fixed this depth chart problem, and a team that would start [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] right away could make the decision for him.

quote.text: He's earned reps. He's not being told he's the guy, and at some point that matters.
quote.by: a person familiar with Gado's thinking

557712426:buried.h: Arizona State's D. Wade Sits Behind the Starter as a 90 Overall
557712426:buried.d: [[p:557712426|D.Wade]] has played just 4 snaps in 14 games. With [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] adding [[r:561121604|B. Beaver]], a source says he may question his path. A quarterback-needy contender would start him tomorrow.

557715842:struggling.h: B. Tuttle Is a 90 on Paper and Invisible on the Stat Sheet
557715842:struggling.d: [[p:557715842|B.Tuttle]] has no catches and no yards in 13 games for a ranked team. A source close to the program says the staff has to decide whether this is a role problem or a fit problem.

quote.text: The talent is there, but the targets aren't.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557717929:struggling.h: USC May Be Done Waiting on J. Reveron to Produce
557717929:struggling.d: [[p:557717929|J.Reveron]] has 10 catches for 120 yards in 12 games despite a 91 overall. A source says [[t:832438398|USC]] has looked at portal receivers.

quote.text: You can't carry a 91 that doesn't touch the ball.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724784:underpaid.h: Rival Collectives Are Calling J. Henderson, and Mississippi State Is Listening
557724784:underpaid.d: [[p:557724784|J.Henderson]] is an 88-overall receiver earning nothing, while peers draw around 80K. A source says [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]] could lose him with one phone call.

557718813:struggling.h: O. Vaughn Has the Rating of a Star and Needs the Role
557718813:struggling.d: [[p:557718813|O.Vaughn]] has 21 catches for 292 yards in 14 games despite an 88 overall on a ranked team. A source says the staff expects him to compete for the job in camp.

quote.text: Nothing is promised. He knows that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557727100:sinking.h: J. Bushnell Deserves Better Than 4-8, and Contenders Know It
557727100:sinking.d: [[p:557727100|J.Bushnell]] is a 91-overall junior receiver stuck on a [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]] team that finished 4-8. A source says winning programs have started to ask about him.

quote.text: If he hits the market, the phones won't stop.

557723757:stayed:2028.h: K.Bing Stays at Ohio State Despite Underpaid Talk
557723757:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557723757|K.Bing]] was on Portal Watch because his rating outran his pay. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. A source close to the program says the money talk happened and it went fine.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557712701:stayed:2028.h: R.Gado Stays Put at Ohio State Even Though He's Buried
557712701:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] looked like a textbook portal candidate, stuck on the depth chart. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff reportedly sat down with him early to lay out a plan.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557725180:stayed:2028.h: Ohio State Holds Onto N.Lautar, Who Looked Like a Scheme Misfit
557725180:stayed:2028.d: [[p:557725180|N.Lautar]] was on Portal Watch as a poor fit for the scheme. The portal is open and he's still at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Whether that's loyalty or a wait-and-see approach is the question for Tuddy_roosevelt's staff.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438301:streakW13.h: East Carolina's 13-0 run has the Pirates believing, and Harrell is selling it
832438301:streakW13.d: [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] is 13-0 and up to No. 2 in the poll. Per a source close to the program, [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] has kept the locker room almost boringly even through all of it.

quote.text: One week at a time. Corny, but it works.

561122840battle.h: Penn State's thin backfield is its pitch to HB Lehan, and Arkansas knows it
561122840battle.d: Four-star HB [[r:561122840|M. Lehan]] wants snaps, and [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has one returning back. That gives it a slight lead over [[t:832438278|Arkansas]], with Georgia lurking. Official visits will likely settle it.

quote.text: He keeps asking who's actually in the room ahead of him. Penn State's answer is a short list.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561122258battle.h: BYU's pass-heavy pitch has Minnesota looking over its shoulder for J. Lindsay
561122258battle.d: Minnesota still holds the lead for [[r:561122258|J. Lindsay]], but playing style is his dealbreaker. [[t:832438288|BYU]] is selling a passing game that fits a route runner. SMU is lurking, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to be a featured piece in the offense. That's the whole conversation right now.
quote.by: a person close to the recruit

561123208battle.h: Nguyen wants to play early, and Minnesota is telling him he will
561123208battle.d: Minnesota has the edge for T. Nguyen, but playing time is the dealbreaker. SMU is pushing, and Tennessee is lurking with a deep-roster pitch. Official visits could swing it.

quote.text: He's not interested in a redshirt year. He's said that to everybody.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561121202battle.h: Minnesota leads for Turpin, but Texas Tech is pitching the NFL hard
561121202battle.d: Pro potential is what matters to J. Turpin, and Texas Tech is chasing Minnesota with a development pitch. SMU sits well back but hasn't gone away. Expect both staffs to push everything they have this week.

quote.text: Every call with Texas Tech comes back to the next level. They know what he's listening for.

561123834battle.h: Pounds wants to stay close to home, and that's a problem for Minnesota
561123834battle.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] leads for four-star WR [[r:561123834|R. Pounds]], but proximity to home is the dealbreaker. That keeps [[t:832438375|SMU]] and TCU in play. Somebody's heart gets broken on signing day.

quote.text: His mom wants him within driving distance. That's not a small thing in this house.
quote.by: a source close to the family

561120014battle.h: Droege is chasing exposure, and SMU barely leads Iowa
561120014battle.d: Brand exposure is the dealbreaker for C. Droege. SMU has a slight edge on Iowa, which isn't going quietly, and Arkansas is lurking. Minnesota fans may notice SMU's name keeps showing up on its board.

quote.text: Iowa thinks the visit changes everything. SMU thinks the TV schedule does.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557725851:breakout.h: Quarterman's 11-point jump leaves East Carolina with an NIL problem
557725851:breakout.d: The junior receiver is up to 80 overall and earning nothing in NIL. [[p:557725851|D.Quarterman]] and [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] may need to talk soon, because bigger programs will be watching film.

quote.text: Guys notice when a teammate jumps like that. So do other collectives.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724319:breakout.h: Gafford is a 90 now, and Penn State's offense has a star to keep
557724319:breakout.d: [[p:557724319|A.Gafford]] jumped to 90 overall, and the sophomore receiver now earns above the going rate. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has more bargaining power than it did last week. Rival programs have taken note.

quote.text: You don't see a jump like that often. Somebody's already asked about him.

557711879:breakout.h: Ohio State's Blue is a 90 and paid like he's not
557711879:breakout.d: Sophomore corner [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] is now 90 overall at 110K in NIL, well under the going rate for corners at his level. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has a gap to close before collectives around the country start calling.

quote.text: A corner like that gets calls from places with deeper pockets. It's only a matter of time.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557713038:breakout.h: Lyle's rise to 89 sharpens Ohio State's quarterback question
557713038:breakout.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is up to 89 overall at 280K, which is more than quarterbacks rated like him usually get. But [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has another sophomore rising behind him, and that makes the roster math awkward for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He's earned the money. He's also looking at that depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724533:underpaid.h: Rival collectives are circling Ohio State safety Gebhardt
557724533:underpaid.d: [[p:557724533|K.Gebhardt]] is an 84-overall safety making nothing in NIL, and players at his level command around 45K. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has been alerted that other programs are watching.

quote.text: A couple of people have already asked about him. That's usually how it starts.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557716293:underpaid.h: Priester is playing like a star and getting paid like a backup
557716293:underpaid.d: [[p:557716293|G.Priester]] is a 92-overall receiver making nothing in NIL, while players like him make around 130K. In the portal, that gap tends to close quickly.

quote.text: Any receiver would see that gap and ask questions. He's no different.

557723242:underpaid.h: Somebody will back up the truck for Slay. Is Bowling Green ready?
557723242:underpaid.d: [[p:557723242|J.Slay]] is an 86-overall quarterback making 15K, while his peers make around 160K. [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]] ranks 134th in NIL spending, so a bidding war is not exactly its specialty.

quote.text: There's money out there for that kind of QB. Bowling Green can't match it.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557718122:fit.h: A.Cain's role is shrinking on a Penn State defense in crisis against the pass
557718122:fit.d: [[p:557718122|A.Cain]] is an 82-overall lurker linebacker. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks 131st of 138 against the pass, and pass defense is where a linebacker like him should make plays. If the defense stays this porous, agerm40 may need to sell him on a fix.

557714021:buried.h: J.Daulton Is a 90-Overall Quarterback Who Hasn't Taken a Snap
557714021:buried.d: Thirteen games, zero snaps for the junior. Contenders with a hole under center have noticed, and [[p:557714021|J.Daulton]] may be the most intriguing name on the board if he enters the portal. He also complicates the F.Brandon conversation.

quote.text: You don't see a 90 at quarterback sitting around very often. Staffs will be calling the minute the window opens.

557727542:buried.h: W.Griffin is a 91-overall quarterback getting almost no snaps at Georgia Tech
557727542:buried.d: [[p:557727542|W.Griffin]] has played just 97 snaps in 12 games as a junior while sitting No. 2 on the Georgia Tech depth chart. Quarterback-needy programs would start him right away, and the portal is coming.

quote.text: A 91 quarterback sitting on the bench is a gift to anyone who needs one. Someone is going to make the call.

557727531:sinking.h: Green deserves better than 4-8, and contenders will be calling
557727531:sinking.d: [[p:557727531|T.Green]] is a 90-overall junior safety on an Arkansas team that's 4-8. If he hits the portal, it will be the story of the offseason.

quote.text: A safety like that wants to play in January. Arkansas can't offer that right now.

557724852:sinking.h: Hopkins is wasted on a 4-8 Army team and every contender knows it
557724852:sinking.d: [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]] is a 90-overall junior quarterback stuck on an Army team that's 4-8. If he enters the portal, he becomes its top prize.

quote.text: Everyone knows his name. Whoever gets the first call has a real shot.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

557715009:sinking.h: M.Cobb Could Be the Portal's Top Prize Out of a 4-8 Notre Dame Team
557715009:sinking.d: The 89-overall junior middle linebacker is playing for a Notre Dame team that went 4-8, and contenders have taken note. Several staffs are expected to call [[p:557715009|M.Cobb]] the moment the window opens.

quote.text: Every contender with a hole at middle linebacker is going to be on the phone with him.

557718668:struggling.h: A.Hurley is a 90-overall receiver who barely shows up in the box score
557718668:struggling.d: Five catches for 57 yards in three games is thin production for [[p:557718668|A.Hurley]], who has top-tier ratings and a spot on a ranked team. Insiders say the target share isn't there. Another quiet month will invite louder questions about the offense and his future.

quote.text: He's a talented kid who isn't getting the ball. Eventually that becomes a conversation about where he'd be happier.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713038:buried.h: B.Lyle Is an 89-Overall Quarterback Watching From Ohio State's Sideline
557713038:buried.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] has taken 8 snaps in 12 games, and the sophomore's camp is reportedly wondering how long he can stay in the No. 2 role. Quarterback-needy programs are already doing their homework.

quote.text: He's too talented to be holding a clipboard. Somebody's going to offer him a job, and it'll be a real one.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724852:struggling.h: R.Hopkins Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Numbers Say Otherwise
557724852:struggling.d: The 90-overall [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]] has 8 interceptions to 5 touchdowns across 140 attempts. Coaches may look at quarterbacks in the portal, and people close to the program say the staff is already preparing for that.

quote.text: The ratings and the production don't match. Everyone sees it.
quote.by: a person familiar with the program's thinking

557715676:struggling.h: Ratings Say 88. The Stat Sheet Says Something Else for K.Largent
557715676:struggling.d: [[p:557715676|K.Largent]] has 31 catches for 433 yards in 13 games. An 88-overall receiver should be doing more, and a source says he has started asking about his role and may want options elsewhere.

quote.text: He wants the ball and wants to produce. That's it.

557728277:struggling.h: D.Peters Hasn't Delivered at Army, and the Offseason Clock Is Ticking
557728277:struggling.d: Eight catches for 167 yards in eight games is far from what an 86-overall receiver should produce. The staff has to decide whether [[p:557728277|D.Peters]] gets a bigger role or whether the portal opens a different door.

quote.text: There's talent there, no question. Right now it's about whether the fit is right for him and for them.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557716595:struggling.h: G.Lovelace Was Billed as a Star Back, and the Staff Faces a Decision
557716595:struggling.d: Sixty-six carries for 259 yards, just 3.9 a carry, isn't what you want from an 85-overall back. The staff has a big decision to make this offseason on [[p:557716595|G.Lovelace]], whether to stick with him or bring in competition.

quote.text: He's not a bust, but he's not what they thought they were getting. That makes the decision harder.
quote.by: a person close to the program

557728494:sinking.h: D.Smith Is an 88-Overall Receiver on a 4-8 Minnesota Team, and Contenders Are Calling
557728494:sinking.d: The junior receiver is stuck on a Minnesota team that went 4-8. His name is circulating among contenders, which is bad timing for a staff trying to sell J. Lindsay on its passing game. [[p:557728494|D.Smith]] could leave.

quote.text: Every contender knows who he is. Minnesota knows it too, and it's got to be uncomfortable.

557717000:struggling.h: Is Wake Forest Ready to Move On From D.Bojorquez?
557717000:struggling.d: [[p:557717000|D.Bojorquez]] hit just 6 of 12 field goals for [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]], and a ranked team can't live with that. Sources say the staff is weighing kicking competition this offseason.

quote.text: You can't have that number in a close game.

557727223:struggling.h: T.Crethers has the 88 rating but not the stat line to match
557727223:struggling.d: [[p:557727223|T.Crethers]] finished with 21 catches for 303 yards in 9 games. The staff faces a real offseason decision on whether he is the answer or just a name on the roster.

quote.text: He looks the part in warmups. Then Saturday comes and the ball just isn't finding him.

831914910:upset.h: Nebraska Stuns No. 7 TCU Despite Getting Outgained
831914910:upset.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] gave up more yards than it gained and still sent [[t:832438381|TCU]] tumbling. Three forced turnovers made the difference, and the Horned Frogs will drop in the polls.

quote.text: We didn't win the stat sheet. We won the football game.
quote.by: a source close to the Nebraska program

831914911:upset.h: Boise State Rolls Texas, and Longhorn Fans Want Answers
831914911:upset.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] outgained and outplayed No. 8 [[t:832438384|Texas]] in a 37-20 win. Burnt-orange boosters were already grumbling about the team's big-game form, and a drop in the polls won't calm them.

quote.text: That wasn't a fluke. They were just tougher than us.

831914910:4th:832438381.h: TCU's Fourth-Down Gamble Backfires, and Fans Are Furious
831914910:4th:832438381.d: [[t:832438381|TCU]] went 3-for-6 on fourth down and turned it over on downs three times in the loss to [[t:832438348|Nebraska]]. The analytics crowd will defend every call. Fans won't, and the postgame mood suggests some players had doubts too.

quote.text: You can be aggressive without handing them the ball in your own territory.
quote.by: a person familiar with TCU's postgame mood

831914361:upset.h: Middle Tennessee Topples New Mexico and Puts Its Coach on Radars
831914361:upset.d: Unranked [[t:832438341|Middle Tennessee]] beat No. 23 [[t:832438350|New Mexico]] 28-17 despite being outgained. Bigger programs notice wins like this, and the rankings committee will have to deal with it this week.

quote.text: People are going to start asking who is running that program.
quote.by: an assistant at a rival program

831914375:upset.h: Kansas State Embarrasses Colorado State in Statement Win
831914375:upset.d: [[t:832438325|Kansas State]] beat No. 25 [[t:832438296|Colorado State]] 51-7, forced three turnovers, and left the Rams' locker room quiet and the booster chatter loud. Colorado State will fall in the polls.

quote.text: That was a beatdown from the first series on.

831914909:ot.h: Texas Tech Survives Washington in Overtime Thriller
831914909:ot.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] edged [[t:832438408|Washington]] 57-55 after taking the extra period 15-13. Neither sideline could breathe at the end, and one Huskies source said the defense will be the topic all offseason.

quote.text: Nobody on our side wanted to see another snap of defense.
quote.by: a person close to the Washington program

831914909:pass:557719497.h: K.Osborne's Seven Touchdowns Can't Save Washington in Heartbreaker
831914909:pass:557719497.d: [[p:557719497|K.Osborne]] threw for 365 yards and seven scores in the 57-55 overtime loss to [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]]. Rival staffs noticed. His night made a strong case for him, even in defeat.

quote.text: He did everything he could. The rest of us have to be better.

831914361:4th:832438350.h: New Mexico's Fourth-Down Bets Come Up Short Against Middle Tennessee
831914361:4th:832438350.d: [[t:832438350|New Mexico]] went 2-for-4 on fourth down, and both misses turned into momentum for [[t:832438341|Middle Tennessee]]. The analytics side will say go for it. The fan base is not in a forgiving mood.

quote.text: Take the points once in a while. That's all I'm asking.

831914378:4th:832438365.h: Oregon State's Aggression Hands Oklahoma the Edge
831914378:4th:832438365.d: [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] was stopped twice on fourth down against [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], going 2-for-4 overall. Fans can live with bold coaching, but not when it keeps handing the ball to the other side.

quote.text: The call is fine. The execution wasn't.
quote.by: a source close to the Oregon State program

831914908:pass:557724658.h: N.Grubbs Torches Wake Forest as Florida State Pulls Away
831914908:pass:557724658.d: [[p:557724658|N.Grubbs]] threw for 412 yards and went 30-of-39 without a pick in a 35-24 [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] loss. The Demon Deacons' secondary had no answer, and the Seminoles looked comfortable all afternoon.

quote.text: He saw everything. We couldn't get him off rhythm.

831914374:ot.h: Syracuse Edges Baylor in Overtime as Bears Wonder What Slipped Away
831914374:ot.d: [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] beat [[t:832438283|Baylor]] 44-41 after taking the extra period 10-7. Baylor had chances to close it out, and the sideline frustration was visible.

quote.text: We had it. We let it get away.
quote.by: a Baylor player, speaking after the game

831914375:int:557727365.h: C.Emanuel's Three Interceptions Sink Colorado State
831914375:int:557727365.d: [[p:557727365|C.Emanuel]] threw three picks in the 51-7 loss to [[t:832438325|Kansas State]]. Many of them were into coverage, and one source said coaches questioned some of his reads on the sideline.

quote.text: He forced it. Everybody saw it.

831914364:pass:557728796.h: R.Wise Shreds Miami for 469 Yards in Ole Miss Rout
831914364:pass:557728796.d: [[p:557728796|R.Wise]] was 29-of-37 with no interceptions in a 50-31 win over [[t:832438337|Miami]]. He made it look easy, and Hurricanes defenders left the field with their heads down.

quote.text: He picked us apart and we couldn't stop it.

831914363:pass:557719284.h: L.Nickel Throws for 419 as Mississippi State Escapes by a Point
831914363:pass:557719284.d: [[p:557719284|L.Nickel]] threw for 419 yards in Mississippi State's 34-33 win over [[t:832438354|North Texas]]. The interception was ugly, but he delivered when it counted, and the Mean Green are left to wonder what might have been.

quote.text: That was too close. We'll take it.

831914365:int:557717254.h: Q.Rambo's Three Picks Doom UNLV Against Wyoming
831914365:int:557717254.d: [[p:557717254|Q.Rambo]] threw three interceptions in the [[t:832438414|Wyoming]] win. [[t:832438397|UNLV]] never recovered, and the quarterback's confidence in the pocket looked shaky all afternoon.

quote.text: He kept pressing. It got worse each series.
quote.by: a person close to the UNLV program

831914366:ot.h: Buffalo Outlasts Coastal Carolina in Low-Scoring Overtime Grinder
831914366:ot.d: [[t:832438287|Buffalo]] took the extra period 3-0 to beat [[t:832438294|Coastal Carolina]] 19-16. It was a defensive slugfest that ended on a field goal, and the Chanticleers were left frustrated on offense.

quote.text: It was ugly, and I'll take ugly all day.

831914356:def:557714739.h: J.Faulk Wrecks Southern Miss With Three Sacks in Colorado Win
831914356:def:557714739.d: [[p:557714739|J.Faulk]] racked up three sacks and three tackles for loss in Colorado's 41-33 win over [[t:832438378|Southern Mississippi]]. Scouts are paying attention, and the Golden Eagles' line had no answer.

quote.text: He was in our backfield all night.

831914360:def:557728102.h: C.Metzner Terrorizes Louisiana With Three Sacks in UAB Rout
831914360:def:557728102.d: [[p:557728102|C.Metzner]] had three sacks and nine tackles in UAB's 38-10 win over [[t:832438330|Louisiana]]. The Ragin' Cajuns' protection broke down and the quarterback never got comfortable.

quote.text: We couldn't block him. Simple as that.

831914358:flags:832438338.h: Miami (OH) Flagged 13 Times in Loss to Toledo
831914358:flags:832438338.d: [[t:832438338|Miami University]] was penalized 13 times for 100 yards against [[t:832438388|Toledo]]. Expect discipline to dominate practice this week, and one source said the staff's patience is thin.

quote.text: It's never the other team that beats us. It's us.
quote.by: a source close to the Miami University program

831914354:to:832438300.h: Eastern Michigan's Four Turnovers Hand Western Kentucky the Win
831914354:to:832438300.d: [[t:832438300|Eastern Michigan]] gave it away four times and [[t:832438411|Western Kentucky]] cashed in. Staffers say the ball security problems are not new, and the coaches know it.

quote.text: You can't win like that. We know it.

831914359:to:832438326.h: Kennesaw State's Sloppy Day Gives Georgia State a Gift
831914359:to:832438326.d: [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] turned it over four times in the loss to [[t:832438314|Georgia State]], and the Panthers cashed in. The Owls left the field wondering how a day got away like that.

quote.text: We beat ourselves. That's all there is to it.

831914371:blowout.h: Clemson Buries Fresno State as Bulldogs Face a Long Film Session
831914371:blowout.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] piled up 476 yards in a 41-6 rout of [[t:832438311|Fresno State]]. The Bulldogs never found their footing, and one source said the film session will be tough.

quote.text: We got outcoached and outplayed. It happens.
quote.by: a source close to the Fresno State program

557715200:struggling.h: C.Keener Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Numbers Say Otherwise
557715200:struggling.d: [[p:557715200|C.Keener]], an 87-overall quarterback, has 12 touchdowns and 11 interceptions. His rating doesn't match his billing, and the staff has a big offseason decision on its hands.

quote.text: There are real questions about whether the production matches the rating.
quote.by: a person familiar with the program

carousel:H0ldStillPlease:pending:8324383.h: Unbeaten and No. 2, Pirate_flag Still Walks Away From East Carolina for Stanford
carousel:H0ldStillPlease:pending:8324383.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Pirate_flag]] has accepted the head coaching job at [[t:832438379|Stanford]] and is leaving [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] at 13-0 and ranked No. 2. The move becomes official once the dynasty finalizes it, and it leaves the Pirates with a very big question.

quote.text: Nobody in that building saw this coming. You don't usually leave a 13-0 team, and the players are going to feel that.
quote.by: a source close to the East Carolina program
